units.source_text: 神护寺和高山寺的坡道都很陡峭。

en.t: The slopes at Jingoji and Kozanji were both very steep.

units.source_text: 已经穿上西式夏装、脚蹬矮跟皮鞋的真砂子倒还好，担心的是穿着和服的千重子不知怎么样。

en.t: Masako, already dressed in Western-style summer clothes and low-heeled leather shoes, would be all right, but she was worried about how Chieko would manage in her kimono.

units.source_text: 她偷偷瞧了一眼千重子。

en.t: She stole a glance at Chieko.

units.source_text: 然而，千重子显得毫不费劲的样子。

en.t: Yet Chieko seemed to be having no trouble at all.
